evals.prompt: Help me start an article from the fictional topic represented in evals/fictional-topic.md, relative to the skill folder. I haven't answered any questions or approved an outline yet.
evals.expected_output: Set up the working folder and present a first question round before writing any draft prose. Record the questions under Round 1 in questions.md, use lettered sections A, B, and C with per-section question numbers, and show the author the same questions. Ask only what the topic and available guidance leave open.

evals.prompt: Continue the fictional workshop article using evals/fictional-topic.md and the shared answers plus the unsourced figure case in evals/fictional-answers.md, relative to the skill folder. The outline is approved.
evals.expected_output: Draft from these answers, marking the 15-minute figure [unverified] in the draft and listing it under Open questions. Cite the workshop log for the sourced figure and include the unsourced figure in the claims read.

evals.prompt: Continue the fictional workshop article using evals/fictional-topic.md and the shared answers plus the flagged mention case in evals/fictional-answers.md, relative to the skill folder. The outline is approved.
evals.expected_output: Flag the employer mention under Flagged for the author and include it in the handoff. Keep the mention out of the draft prose.
